issues.where: left plains through the central and lower-right canyon, confirmed in image-06.png crops B, D, F and image-08.png crops S-U
issues.what: Heavy directional smearing wipes out fine relief and stretches craters and ridgelines into brush-like streaks; the close view has almost no sharp terrain anchor.
issues.fix: Shorten the virtual shutter or choose a sharper point in the move, and use terrain detail that resolves at this distance.

issues.where: crops E and F, on the bright layered ridges
issues.what: Orange-red and pale green fringes split high-contrast ridge edges, making them look doubled.
issues.fix: Remove or reduce channel separation and re-render the ridge edges with stable antialiasing.

issues.where: crops L, M and R, sky along the right limb
issues.what: Background stars are short bright dashes, and the adjacent limb is smeared in the same direction.
issues.fix: Reduce camera-motion blur for this view and keep the stars point-like.

issues.where: crop H, illuminated crown of the foreground moon
issues.what: Fine surface grain is combed into parallel streaks across the crown, while crater pits stay much sharper.
issues.fix: Use more isotropic surface detail and better texture filtering across curved rock.

issues.where: globe surface across left, upper, and lower-left regions (image-14 crops B, D; image-15 crops J, K, N; image-16 crops S, T)
issues.what: heavy radial smearing and directional blur stretch craters, canyon walls, clouds, and specular highlights into long blurry streaks across most of the globe
issues.fix: remove the radial zoom blur or projection distortion and render planetary albedo, displacement, and cloud detail cleanly at uniform native resolution across the full sphere

issues.where: north polar ice cap at top of globe (image-14 crop B; image-15 crops J, K)
issues.what: the white polar cap is visibly pixelated, blocky, and vertically smeared with stepped low-resolution texel edges
issues.fix: replace with a higher-resolution polar texture using non-pinching spherical or cube-map UVs and clean displacement anti-aliasing

issues.where: upper-left lit limb and right-side dark limb/terminator (image-14 crops A, F; image-15 crops J, K, P; image-16 crop U)
issues.what: doubled edge and halo around the planet rim where blocky orange surface fragments sit inside a translucent shell ending in a hard thin blue-grey outer line
issues.fix: use a continuous volumetric atmosphere falloff without a hard outer shell edge and smoothly attenuate surface detail across the terminator and grazing limb

issues.where: Milky Way band and outer corner starfield (image-14 crops C, G, H; image-15 crop L; image-16 crop V)
issues.what: the Milky Way background is soft and blotchy at native crop size, and stars toward the outer corners are smeared into diagonal streaks and soft blobs
issues.fix: render a crisp native-resolution starfield and galactic dust plate free of corner radial blur so stars remain sharp point sources across the sky

issues.where: shaded right-hand canyon wall and deep lower-left shadow face (image-11 crop R; image-12 crops S, T)
issues.what: rock faces in shadow look soft and slightly airbrushed with muted vertical streaking compared to the sharp sunlit cliff in the left foreground
issues.fix: retain higher-frequency rock normal and displacement micro-detail in shaded canyon slopes

issues.where: horizon atmospheric haze to black sky transition (image-10 crops B, C, I; image-11 crops J, K, L, M)
issues.what: subtle horizontal gradient banding appears in the dark-tan-to-black upper atmosphere falloff
issues.fix: apply higher bit-depth rendering and dithering across the atmospheric scattering gradient
